name: chenile-process-management
description: Process server and headless worker mini-monoliths with optional dedicated service registry

inputFields.name: application
inputFields.description: Process deployment application name (lowercase Java identifier)

inputFields.name: processSpec
inputFields.description: Native processMap definitions with optional inputFields and outputFields

inputFields.name: cronSpec
inputFields.description: Optional JSON array of cron schedules (separate from process definitions)

inputFields.name: registryMode
inputFields.description: Create a service registry or use an existing registry

inputFields.name: existingRegistryUrl
inputFields.description: Existing Chenile service registry base URL

inputFields.name: workerDeploymentUrl
inputFields.description: Worker deployment URL (host identity/health; work arrives over Kafka)

inputFields.name: workTopic
inputFields.description: Default Kafka topic when a process definition has no config.queue

inputFields.name: super_pom
inputFields.description: Optional parent POM for the generated project
inputFields.helpText: Object with groupId, artifactId, version and relativePath. Omit to keep the blueprint parent.

inputFields.name: dependencies
inputFields.helpText: Additional dependencies for the generated server-service JAR.
